channel.title: Humanoid News
channel.description: Independent, answer-first news on humanoid robots: Tesla Optimus, Figure, Agility, Boston Dynamics, Unitree, 1X and more.

item.title: AGIBOT pitches 'Worken' as a measure of useful robot work and shows AHA3, GO-3 Preview and G2 Max
item.description: At its Innovation Day 2026 in Shanghai on 29 October, AGIBOT proposed a robot productivity metric called Worken and showed a third-generation humanoid architecture, new AI models, the G2 Max robot and an open-source operating system plan, according to the company.

item.title: Why Tau Robotics' humanoid home-cleaning subscription is trending
item.description: A 29 October post from Tau Robotics' founder announcing recurring bookings for its supervised humanoid cleaners in San Francisco passed 670,000 views on X within a day. Here is what the service is, according to the company, and what to watch.

item.title: Samsung's chairman visited the RX robotics office on his fourth anniversary in the role
item.description: Lee Jae-yong visited Samsung's RX robotics office in Seoul on 27 October, his fourth anniversary as chairman, Korean papers report.

item.title: NEURA aims to run five robot gyms by the end of 2026, the New York Times reports
item.description: The New York Times reports NEURA aims to run five robot gyms by year-end, including one open in Hangzhou, China.

item.title: What humanoid makers have published about runtime and recharge
item.description: Agility says Digit 5 will run 90 minutes and recharge in 9; 1X lists 4 hours for NEO; Unitree lists about 3 hours for the H2.

item.title: Google opens Gemini Robotics ER 2, a high-level 'robot brain' model, to cloud customers in public preview
item.description: Google says its Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 model, which plans and checks tasks for robots from arms to humanoids, is now in public preview on its Gemini platform for enterprise developers.

item.title: Samsung is developing five-finger, tendon-style robot hands for its humanoid, Korean paper reports
item.description: The Hankyoreh reports that Samsung Electronics' new robotics division is building a humanoid with cable-driven, five-fingered hands, as Korean groups prepare humanoid showings ahead of CES 2027.

item.title: Imperial spinout Machenta raises $40 million seed round for robots that learn a task from one demonstration
item.description: London-based Machenta, spun out of Imperial College London, says its simulation-trained model lets robots, including humanoids, learn new tasks after seeing them done once.

item.title: Why Reward AI's OM-1 humanoid parcel-delivery and stairs demo is getting attention
item.description: Reward AI posted video of humanoids running its OM-1 model to carry parcels from a vehicle and handle objects on stairs; the post passed 300,000 views on X within a day.

item.title: GXO adds Agility's Digit at two more US warehouses as Agility names three new paid manufacturing programs
item.description: GXO plans to deploy Agility Robotics' Digit humanoid at sites in Statesville, North Carolina, and Lebanon, Tennessee, from early 2027, and Agility says three unnamed manufacturers have joined paid programs.

item.title: CASBOT raises several hundred million yuan as it reports over RMB 400 million in shoemaking-robot orders
item.description: Beijing embodied-AI company CASBOT has closed an A++ round worth several hundred million yuan and says it holds more than RMB 400 million in 2026 orders for shoemaking robots.

item.title: Robot e-skin startup MoSense raises about RMB 100 million five months after founding
item.description: Shanghai-based MoSense, which develops whole-body tactile sensing for robots, has raised an angel-plus round of around RMB 100 million led by CDH Investments and Oasis Capital, with LimX Dynamics among the backers.

item.title: Low-cost humanoid maker Noetix has confidentially filed for a Hong Kong IPO, Bloomberg reports
item.description: Beijing-based Noetix Robotics, maker of the RMB 9,998 Bumi humanoid, has confidentially filed for a Hong Kong listing that could raise several hundred million dollars, according to a Bloomberg report relayed by TechNode.

item.title: Unitree's new H2-X humanoid loses a lower leg after a side flip at a Hangzhou conference
item.description: A Unitree H2-X humanoid fell while landing a side flip at the World Physical AI Conference in Hangzhou and one lower leg detached at the joint, TechNode reported; Unitree had not publicly commented.

item.title: ETH Zürich's ACP policy lets a Unitree G1 climb ladders, vault and get back up after falls
item.description: Researchers at ETH Zürich's Robotic Systems Lab report a single learned policy, Attention-based Contact Planning, that plans where a humanoid's hands, knees, feet and pelvis should touch the terrain, letting a Unitree G1 climb, vault and recover from falls.

item.title: 110 AgiBot A3 humanoids set a Guinness record for the most robots dancing at once
item.description: AgiBot ran 110 Expedition A3 humanoids through a synchronised routine in Jinan on 24 October, and a Guinness World Records adjudicator confirmed it as a new record for the most humanoid robots dancing simultaneously.

item.title: Amazon-led team teaches a humanoid to hold boxes against its torso and under its arm
item.description: A preprint from Amazon, UC San Diego and the University of Michigan describes Whole-Body Dexterity, a controller that lets a teleoperated Unitree G1 brace objects against its arms and torso, completing 45 of 50 real-world trials.

item.title: ROKAE says it has delivered its 10,000th humanoid force-controlled arm
item.description: Hong Kong-listed ROKAE Robotics says it has delivered 10,000 humanoid force-controlled arms, and that five of its Helios wheeled humanoids work on Schaeffler's humanoid-parts line in Taicang.

item.title: Yaskawa aims to bring a humanoid to market within one to two years, reports say
item.description: Japanese industrial robot maker Yaskawa Electric plans to put a humanoid on the market within one to two years, building on its Tokyo Robotics acquisition, according to Nikkei reporting relayed by Robot Newspaper and Vuntum.

item.title: Realbotix opens reservations for Echo companion humanoids, with deliveries planned for late 2027
item.description: Realbotix has launched Echo, a line of companion humanoids priced at $11,950 for a tabletop model and $59,950 for a full-body model, with a first run of 250 units planned for the second half of 2027, the company says.

item.title: Toyota and Honda test humanoid robots on Japanese factory lines, from wire harnesses to final inspection
item.description: Toyota and Honda are trialling humanoid robots in Japanese plants on tasks including wire-harness installation and final vehicle inspection, according to Automotive News reporting picked up widely on 26 October.

item.title: FAW-Volkswagen widens UBTECH humanoid trials from inspection to factory logistics
item.description: FAW-Volkswagen and UBTECH have agreed to develop and test humanoid robots for factory logistics, building on Walker S Lite inspection trials at the carmaker's Qingdao plant. No robot numbers, sites or timetable have been given.

item.title: Agility moves Digit 5 onto NVIDIA IGX Thor and expands in Pittsburgh
item.description: Agility Robotics says Digit 5 will run on NVIDIA IGX Thor compute, and that it is opening a 50,000 sq ft Pittsburgh hub and holds over $300M in multi-year Digit 5 orders.

item.title: AGCO plans a Digit humanoid pilot at its Hesston, Kansas, factory from 2027
item.description: Farm-machinery maker AGCO and Agility Robotics say they have signed a commercial agreement to pilot the Digit humanoid at AGCO's Hesston, Kansas, plant, starting in 2027.

item.title: Figure says Figure 04 is in design lock and teases Helix 3.0 in a public all-hands
item.description: In a published all-hands recording, Figure CEO Brett Adcock said Figure 04 has reached design lock, its Index app has 37.5 million human videos, and previewed Helix 3.0.

item.title: Alibaba's Amap team releases λ0, a humanoid model trained largely on human video
item.description: Researchers at Alibaba's Amap and Token Hub released λ0, a whole-body humanoid model trained on a 500-hour human video dataset; they report 62.5% success on four real-world tasks with a Unitree G1.

item.title: XPENG shows IRON switching between handshakes, fist bumps and high fives
item.description: A new XPENG video shows its IRON humanoid adapting as a tester changes gestures mid-movement; XPENG credits its VLA 2.0 model, which it says re-evaluates the scene every 0.2 seconds.

item.title: NEURA unveils a lighter 4NE1 Gen 4 humanoid as the TUM RoboGym opens near Munich
item.description: NEURA says its 4NE1 Gen 4 humanoid is 20% lighter and being readied for series production; it launched at the new TUM RoboGym near Munich Airport.

item.title: Generative Bionics plans a 5,000 m² humanoid training "data factory" in Italy with AMD
item.description: Generative Bionics says it will build a three-site Physical AI Data Factory network, starting with a 5,000 m² Italian hub due by Q4 2027, using AMD compute.

item.title: AiMOGA opens worldwide pre-orders for Mobo, a 0.9 m family companion humanoid
item.description: AiMOGA Robotics says it has opened global pre-orders for Mobo, a 0.9-metre home companion humanoid with 22 degrees of freedom; no price was announced.

item.title: Chinese humanoid makers seek factory and cafe trials in South Korea
item.description: UBTech, Anyverse Dynamics and other Chinese firms are pursuing trials in South Korea as Seoul proposes 3.1 trillion won for physical AI, Korea Times reports.

item.title: Why UCLA's PhoneBot, a small humanoid run by a smartphone, is getting attention
item.description: UCLA's open-source PhoneBot uses an Android phone for sensing and computing in a 48 cm biped that its researchers say costs about $400 without the phone.

item.title: Unitree says it is building "Rehearsal", a self-improving loop for robot software
item.description: Unitree's Wang Xingxing said on 22 Oct 2026 the firm is developing "Rehearsal", a loop for robots to write code, test it in simulation and improve (SCMP).

item.title: Why Unitree's H2-X "Guardian" video is getting attention
item.description: Unitree's H2-X teaser shows martial arts and staged rescue scenes; outlets note it released few specifications and it is unclear how autonomous the demos were.

item.title: Why Figure's nine-day Figure 03 treadmill test is getting attention
item.description: Figure CEO Brett Adcock said a Figure 03 robot walked 348 miles over nine days on a treadmill; outlets note power and interruption details are unclear.

item.title: Tesla targets end of 2027 for external Optimus deliveries, Musk says
item.description: Elon Musk said on Tesla's Q3 2026 earnings call that Tesla expects to start delivering Optimus robots to outside customers around the end of 2027, according to Electrek.

item.title: Danish grocer Føtex pilots Unitree humanoids for overnight restocking
item.description: Føtex, part of Salling Group, has started a multi-year pilot with HIVE Robots to train humanoid robots to restock shelves after closing time, ESM Magazine reports.

item.title: Berkeley's SuperMimic trains a humanoid motion controller in three hours on one GPU, authors report
item.description: UC Berkeley researchers report that SuperMimic matched a baseline humanoid motion tracker that trained for seven days on 128 GPUs, using three hours on one GPU.

item.title: NVIDIA expands Isaac robotics platform as Agile Robots unveils Agile ONE SN humanoid
item.description: At GTC Berlin on 21 October 2026, NVIDIA announced additions to its Isaac robotics platform and Agile Robots announced the Agile ONE SN reference humanoid, according to NVIDIA.

item.title: Schaeffler opens Taicang factory where humanoids help build parts for humanoids
item.description: Schaeffler says its new Taicang, China factory uses six humanoids to assemble joint modules, including actuators, for other humanoid robots.

item.title: Eka Robotics announces $150M Series A for force-sensing robot manipulation
item.description: Eka Robotics said on 20 October 2026 it raised a $150 million Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz and F-Prime; SiliconANGLE reports a $1.45 billion valuation.

item.title: China expects over 100,000 humanoid robots built in 2026 as first national standards approach
item.description: A Chinese ministry official said China expects over 100,000 humanoids built in 2026, per China's SCIO; first national standards apply from April 2027.

item.title: South Korea grants safety-rule exemption for 20 Robros humanoids in factory pilot
item.description: A Korean regulatory-sandbox committee granted Robros an exemption so 20 of its humanoid robots can work near people at four companies' sites, Seoul Economic Daily reports.

item.title: Minerva Humanoids says it raised about $10M pre-seed led by General Catalyst
item.description: San Francisco start-up Minerva Humanoids said on 6 October 2026 it has raised about $10 million in pre-seed funding led by General Catalyst, according to its press release.
